name: Underwater Giants
description: Write eight scenes. Every scene becomes an image, every image a five second shot, edited together with music and posted.

data.label: Scene 1
data.prompt: Two divers slowly descend through clear blue water and suddenly discover a massive living room on the ocean floor. A gigantic sofa the size of a building, a coffee table as large as a small field, huge cushions gently drifting with the current. Soft sun rays penetrate from above, creating a calm, luxurious atmosphere. The divers appear tiny like ants inside a space built for giants.

data.label: Scene 2
data.prompt: A diver swims beside a giant coffee cup as large as an entire room. Colorful coral reefs grow along its rim, and small fish swim inside the cup like it’s a miniature lagoon. The handle is big enough for a diver to swim through.

data.label: Scene 3
data.prompt: A colossal armchair the height of a four-story building stands on the seabed. Massive cushions are covered with soft coral and sea plants. One diver hovers near the armrest while another shines a light upward, revealing the unbelievable scale.

data.label: Scene 5
data.prompt: A giant open book lies on the ocean floor, each page the size of a field. Deeply carved letters are filled with glowing algae. A diver swims across one of the letters as if crossing a landscape.

data.label: Scene 6
data.prompt: A massive fruit bowl sits on a giant stone table. Instead of fruit, vibrant corals and small sea creatures fill the bowl. Fish swim through it like a living underwater garden.

data.label: Scene 7
data.prompt: A giant bed with flowing white fabric rests on the seabed. The sheets move gently with the current like soft clouds. Above it hangs a massive lamp, surrounded by glowing jellyfish that illuminate the scene with soft, magical light.
data.errorMessage: The operation was aborted due to timeout

data.label: Scene 8
data.prompt: Final wide shot. The camera pulls back to reveal the full environment — an enormous area filled with oversized everyday objects: giant sofas, books, cups, chairs, and living room elements scattered across the ocean floor. The divers look incredibly small within a surreal underwater world that feels like a frozen luxury living space built for giants.

data.label: How to use this template

data.text:
Each scene starts with a Text Prompt node.
You can:

Change the concept (e.g. desert / space / city)
Adjust details (objects, lighting, mood, scale)
Keep structure but swap theme

Tip: Keep the “giant scale + small human” contrast — it’s what makes the video feel viral.
data.label: Step 1 — Edit the scenes (optional)

data.text:
Run the image nodes (Scenes 1 - 8).
Each scene produces a high-quality visual.

If needed:

Re-run specific scenes

Slightly tweak prompts for better composition
data.label: Step 2 - Generate images

data.text:
Each image feeds into an Image-to-Video node.

Already configured:

Subtle cinematic motion
Stable structure (no morphing)
Smooth camera movement

You can tweak:

Camera motion (zoom / orbit / pan)
Motion intensity
data.label: Step 3 - Turn images into video

data.text:
The flow automatically:

Merges all clips

Adds transitions

Creates a continuous story

No action needed unless you want to:

Change clip order

Adjust transition duration
data.label: Step 4 - Combine all scenes

data.text:
The Suno node generates cinematic background music.

You can:

Change mood (epic / dark / emotional / ambient)

Add vocals if needed
data.label: Step 5 - Add music

data.text:
The flow:

Merges video + audio

Trims to optimal length

Formats for Instagram
data.label: Step 6 - Final output

data.text:
Connected Instagram node will:

Upload the video as a Reel
Use the provided caption

Edit caption in:
👉 Caption / Post Text node
